answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded escrow account whose balance is attested through a rotating quorum, so a forged persona cannot survive the gale of periodic audits without collateral. Each transaction emits a signed signal anchored to a nebula of cross-linked ledger hashes, letting forensic reconciliation trace shared funding roots. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
